title: Fix Structure Mode edit label position drag
description:
Edit label position in Structure Mode was not moving labels on click-drag. Drag used the wrong coordinate space (world vs page-local), and continuous Viewer overlays blocked pointer hits on the label text. Labels can now be dragged again; Escape still cancels.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map38). Structure Mode → right-click a node → Edit label position → drag the label.
changeLog: Fix label drag to use page-local offsets matching how markers are painted.
Make continuous Viewer label text hittable during tether edit.
Re-apply tether-edit chrome after overlay refresh so drag keeps working.
